name: Kale Salad with Peppers, Prosciutto, Pine Nuts & Anchovy Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 yellow bell peppers
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
3 bunches kale

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Add tomatoes to the baking sheets with the peppers. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and crushed red pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are browned and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add pine nuts and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool.
Mince anchovy fillets. Place in a large bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the anchovy along with oil, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
85 g Parmesan cheese
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup red wine vinegar
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and, using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Drain and roughly chop olives and artichokes. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
1 ½ (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
When the veggies are cool, add to the bowl along with toasted pine nuts. Gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
